name: Den nervöse praktikanten
text: A nervous intern approaches you in the parking lot. 'I have documents, but if anyone finds out...' They clutch a folder to their chest, eyes darting left and right.

choices.label: Take the documents (risky but rewarding)
Reassure them and protect their identity
Walk away — too dangerous

name: Vänlig Redaktör
text: Your editor calls. 'Good work out there. I can either give you a bonus or we can invest in upgrading your equipment.'

choices.label: Take the bonus (+50 Press Passes)
Upgrade equipment (upgrade a random card)

name: Stämning
text: A lawyer slaps you with a defamation lawsuit outside the courthouse. 'You can settle out of court, or fight it — but it'll cost you time and energy.'

choices.label: Settle out of court (-60 Press Passes)
Fight it (Lose 10 Credibility, but gain a powerful card)
Ignore it (gain Lawsuit curse)

name: Gammal Källa
text: An old source from your early days reaches out. 'I can help you, but I need a favor first. There's a story that needs to be buried.'

choices.label: Help them (gain a relic, lose 15 Credibility)
Refuse and keep your integrity (+10 Max Credibility)

name: Byfånet
text: The town drunk stumbles up to you with a conspiratorial whisper. Most of what he says is nonsense, but something about 'the mayor's secret boat' sounds interesting...

choices.label: Buy him a drink and listen (-20💰, gain a random card)
Politely excuse yourself

name: Hemlig Leverans
text: A plain brown envelope appears under your door. Inside: a USB drive and a note saying 'Use wisely. There is no going back.'

choices.label: Plug it in (gain powerful card, risk +Spin)
Have IT scan it first (lose the surprise, gain 25 💰)
Destroy it (safe, +5 Credibility)

name: Vagnhallen
text: An abandoned warehouse at the docks. Someone left a cache of documents inside. But the area is watched by security cameras.

choices.label: Sneak in (-8 Credibility, remove a random card from deck)
Come back at night with backup (+30 💰)

name: Tipstelefonen
text: The anonymous tip line rings at 3 AM. A disguised voice tells you: 'Check the third drawer in the city clerk's desk.' Do you trust this?

choices.label: Go investigate immediately (gain a random rare card)
It's a trap — stay home and rest
Report the tip to your editor (+40 💰)
